messages:
drew: Quick heads-up — did bring-up of `llama-compat-v2` int8 on same A100 SKU across AWS/GCP/Azure. p50/p95 close, p99 on Azure is 2.8s vs ~1.1s on GCP and 1.3s on AWS :confused:

maya: ugh. do we have driver / cuda diffs? nvidia-smi outputs?

drew: pasted minimal outputs:
```
GCP: Driver 535.86, CUDA 12.2
AWS: Driver 535.54, CUDA 12.2
Azure: Driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1
```

maya: interesting — Azure same driver but older CUDA. also check kernel/firmware and nv_peer_mem? can you dump `dmesg | grep -i nvidia`?

drew: here — only saw a few thermal throttles, nothing obvious. also ran perf:
```
model=llama-compat-v2, batch=8, seq=1024, quant=int8
GCP: p50 120ms p95 430ms p99 1100ms t/s 3.4
AWS: p50 130ms p95 450ms p99 1300ms t/s 3.1
Azure: p50 125ms p95 460ms p99 2800ms t/s 1.4
```

infra-bot: perf-run 1732504321: started on aws/gcp/azure, artifacts => /ci/artifacts/1732504321

sophia: have you tried disabling convolution heuristics / forcing cublasLt alg? sometimes quant kernels pick slow fallback on specific CUDA combos.

ben: also check `GPU_CLOCK`/power cap differences and whether MIG is active. Azure images sometimes ship different firmware.

maya: assigning a minimal repro: run matmul microbench against `triton` backend with env `CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8` and `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` — we should compare kernel selection logs.

drew: launching now on all three with script:
```
./run_micro.sh --matmul --iters 2000 --size 4096
ENV: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
```

sam: also add `TF32_OVERRIDE=0` and `export TF32=0` to force fp32 path for parity.

drew: run results incoming, will post trace and `cudaProfiler` output.

maya: if Azure still worse, let's try `LD_PRELOAD` with our custom cuBLAS shim to log algos, maybe kernel fallback due to heuristics.

ben: quick ask — did we enable `persistent_kv_cache`? that sometimes amplifies tail under certain memcpy paths.

drew: disabled it; still seeing p99 gap. attaching snippet of `nvprof` where Azure shows repeated kernel `gemm_..._fallback` calls.

(kernellog excerpt)
Azure: gemm_algo=FALLBACK id=0x7f...
GCP: gemm_algo=LT_ALGO_1 id=0x2a...

sophia: that points to driver/CUDA lower-level selection. Try setting `CUBLAS_LT_ALGO_CONFIG` to force `LT_ALGO_1` on Azure as a test.

maya: timeline: if forcing algos fixes p99, we'll add a runtime flag in our deployer and file a bug to NV/infra.

drew: ok running forced-algo test on Azure now.

infra-bot: perf-run 1732504321: artifacts uploaded -> /ci/artifacts/1732504321/forced-algo

drew: forced-algo on Azure p99 dropped to 1.15s. so it's an algo pick issue :white_check_mark:

maya: great. next steps: (1) reproduce with upstream driver/CUDA combos (2) add runtime override flag and telemetry to detect fallback algos (3) open ticket with NV

ben: I'll look into power/firmware differences and patch infra image if needed.

sam: note for docs: add known-workaround for quant int8 fallback on certain CUDA combos.

drew: thx team. assigning follow-ups: @maya run deterministic microbench matrix across drivers; @ben check images; @sophia add runtime flag PR. I'll collate perf artifacts.

maya: on it :memo:

sophia: will draft PR later today.

drew: closing for now, will re-open if we see regression after image patch. :wave:
